verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies pieces of an interview plan. Greenhouse has scorecard questions that AI notes map onto (docs-9, docs-21), an "interview workflow" that assessments plug into (docs-19), and pipeline stages that applications advance through (docs-18, docs-20). Nothing documents a per-role interview plan as a single configurable object. Missing for 10: explicit per-job interview plan configuration, question banks, per-interviewer focus areas or assignments, define-once/reuse templating across roles, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
